mask_audit.note: joint_tokenization_roundtrip is informational: training uses separately encoded prompt and target

recipe.failure_policy: Amendment 1 item 11: infrastructure -> one from-scratch retry; numerical/protocol -> study halts
recipe.loss_reduction: mean over each example's supervised tokens, divided by accumulation (examples weighted equally)
recipe.pairing_scope: pairing controls the initial adapter tensors and the exposure order, not dropout draws
recipe.seeding: random, torch and CUDA seeded with the run seed before the adapter is created and before training
recipe.valid_run: 60 successful optimizer steps over 480 visits; no scaler skips or nonfinite values
